The '''Werta system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

A [[Unidentified moon (Werta system)|populated moon]] housed a [[Unidentified Rebel base (Werta system moon)|Rebel Alliance base]].<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
